_note: The strategic frames an HLR route may lead, the plan's bounds and any standing policy. Read by brief-intake and brief_lint.js through lib/pack.js loadRouteAxes. Built 2026-10-18 by lane D. Ratified by Eddie on 2026-10-18 on Gate 2 call 6 a, the file's one open call: the six frames, 3 routes by default, 5 at most and no standing policy stand as drafted.

ratification.ruling: Gate 2 call 6 a: no standing angle policy; the file stands as drafted

provenance.axes: [derived] the engine's six frames, kept whole: each one is supportable from HLR's live work (axis_notes). No HLR-only frame is added (engine_compatibility).
provenance.counts: [derived] the engine defaults, 3 and 5; nothing in HLR's material argues for others.
provenance.standing_angle_policy: ruled: none (Gate 2 call 6 a, Eddie, 2026-10-18). With it empty, an unattended run selects every route and marks the plan provisional.

axis_notes.benefit: What the piece does in the wearer's life. HLR's live benefit language is health-adjacent and intention-led ("CALM YOUR ANXIETY", "Protect your energy"; tags such as Calm and Protection): every benefit line needs a sourced fact in products.json and waits for C2. A benefit route no source can carry stays empty.
axis_notes.occasion: A moment in the calendar. [observed] monthly rituals (energy medicine, zodiac seasons, birthstone months), Mother's Day (2:57602), Valentine story sets, Black Friday and holiday events, launches.
axis_notes.product: The piece itself: its stone, metal, making and wear. [observed] annotated builds and callouts (P-ANNOT-BUILD, S-ANNOT), spotlights, the Seeds of and Spell Bracelet families. Names and materials resolve through the product database.
axis_notes.proof: Someone else's words. [observed] Judge.me reviews (72 on one bracelet), press quotes, DM replies. Verbatim and sourced only; origin, karat and warranty statements wait for Review 1 (addendum 6).
axis_notes.urgency: A deadline or a limited offer. [observed] "THIS WEEK ONLY", LIGHT25 and LIGHT30 events, order cutoffs. Offers stay merge tokens until C10.
axis_notes.curiosity: Something the reader did not know. [observed] stone meanings, zodiac season crystals (S-SEASON), education carousels (S-LONG) and question-led headline tiles (S-PHOTOTEXT). Meaning lines are claims (C2), so a curiosity route needs sourced facts before copy.

engine_compatibility: Each axis is one of the engine's frames, which are also the email angle gate's axes. copy_lint.js refuses an angle option whose axis is outside the gate's set or off the selected route's axis, so an HLR-only frame (for example ritual or meaning) would fail every email run inside that route. Logged as an engine gap in structure-notes.md; HLR's ritual and meaning content leads through occasion and curiosity meanwhile.
